title: Nixon's 1960 assassination team killed JFK

tellings.quote: that in fact the assassination team that was created back in 1960 by Richard Nixon are the ones that killed the president

plain: An assassination team that Richard Nixon set up in 1960 was the team that killed President Kennedy in Dallas. Dan Sheehan says this on the show, passing on what he was told and citing names including Santo Trafficante Jr., Andy Toney and William Johnstone Taylor. If true, it would tie the Kennedy killing to a secret operation started years earlier.
